questions.questionText: Your company processes thousands of PDF invoices from various vendors every day. You need a managed Google Cloud service to automatically extract structured data such as vendor name, invoice date, and total amount without building custom machine learning models. Which service should you choose?

explanation.general explanation: Document AI is a document understanding solution that takes unstructured data (e.g., PDF invoices, forms) and makes the data easier to understand, analyze, and consume. It includes pre-trained models specifically for invoices, receipts, and other business documents.

why other options are wrong.Cloud Vision API: While Cloud Vision API has OCR capabilities to extract raw text from images, it does not automatically structure the data into key-value pairs like vendor name or invoice amount.
why other options are wrong.Cloud Natural Language API: This API is used for analyzing text for sentiment, entities, and syntax, not for extracting structured data from visual document formats like PDF invoices.
why other options are wrong.Vertex AI AutoML Vision: AutoML Vision is used to train custom image classification or object detection models. It is not designed for document parsing and requires you to build and train your own model.

questions.questionText: A team of data analysts wants to predict customer churn based on historical transactional data stored in Google Cloud. The analysts are proficient in SQL but have no experience with Python, TensorFlow, or machine learning frameworks. Which Google Cloud service is the best fit for this requirement?

explanation.general explanation: BigQuery ML lets data analysts create, train, evaluate, and predict with machine learning models using standard SQL queries directly inside BigQuery, eliminating the need to move data or learn specialized ML frameworks.

why other options are wrong.Vertex AI Workbench: Workbench is a Jupyter-based environment intended for data scientists who write Python or R code to build custom models.
why other options are wrong.Vertex AI Custom Training: Custom Training requires building and packaging custom ML code using frameworks like TensorFlow or PyTorch, which requires ML engineering expertise.
why other options are wrong.Cloud Dataflow: Dataflow is a data processing service for batch and streaming pipelines, not a platform for building machine learning models using SQL.

questions.questionText: A retail company wants to analyze audio recordings from their customer service calls to determine if customers are expressing positive or negative emotions regarding their recent purchases. Which TWO Google Cloud services should be combined to achieve this? (Select two)

explanation.general explanation: To analyze sentiment from audio recordings, the audio must first be converted into text using the Cloud Speech-to-Text API. Once the text transcript is generated, the Cloud Natural Language API can be used to perform sentiment analysis on the text to determine positive or negative emotions.

why other options are wrong.Cloud Vision API: The Cloud Vision API is used for analyzing images and extracting information from visual data, not for processing audio or text.
why other options are wrong.Dialogflow: Dialogflow is used to build conversational agents (chatbots and voicebots). While it uses speech recognition and natural language understanding internally, it is not the right service for batch analyzing pre-recorded audio for sentiment.
why other options are wrong.Document AI: Document AI is used to extract structured data from documents (like PDFs and forms), not for analyzing audio recordings.

questions.questionText: A manufacturing company needs to identify specific, proprietary defects on their assembly line using cameras. They have thousands of labeled images of these unique defects but do not have an in-house team of machine learning engineers to write custom neural networks. Which service should they use?

explanation.general explanation: Vertex AI AutoML Vision allows users to train high-quality custom machine learning models with minimal machine learning expertise. Since the company needs to identify proprietary, unique defects (not general objects), they need a custom model, making AutoML the perfect fit.

why other options are wrong.Cloud Vision API: The pre-trained Vision API is excellent for recognizing common objects, text, and landmarks, but it cannot recognize proprietary or company-specific defects out-of-the-box without custom training.
why other options are wrong.Vertex AI Workbench: Workbench is a development environment for data scientists to write custom ML code. The company lacks the ML engineers required to utilize this effectively.
why other options are wrong.Cloud Video Intelligence API: This API is for analyzing video content, but like the pre-trained Vision API, it only detects common, pre-trained entities unless custom trained.

questions.questionText: Your machine learning team has written a highly customized TensorFlow model to predict housing prices. They need a fully managed Google Cloud service to train this model across multiple GPUs and then deploy it as a REST API for online predictions. Which service is most appropriate?
options: Vertex AI Custom Training and Prediction
correctAnswers: Vertex AI Custom Training and Prediction

explanation.general explanation: Vertex AI Custom Training allows you to bring your own custom ML code (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch) and run it on managed compute clusters with GPUs. After training, Vertex AI Prediction allows you to deploy the model to an endpoint for scalable, low-latency online predictions.

why other options are wrong.BigQuery ML: BigQuery ML is used for training models using SQL. It does not support running custom, pre-written TensorFlow scripts.
why other options are wrong.Cloud Run: While you could technically containerize a model and deploy it to Cloud Run for serving, it is not a training platform and does not offer natively managed ML training with GPU clusters like Vertex AI.
why other options are wrong.AutoML Tabular: AutoML is for building models without writing the ML code. Since the team has already written a custom TensorFlow model, AutoML is not applicable.

questions.questionText: An e-commerce website wants to increase sales by displaying personalized product suggestions to users based on their browsing history and past purchases. The company wants a fully managed solution tailored for retail without building recommendation algorithms from scratch. Which service should they choose?
options: Vertex AI Search for Retail (Recommendations AI)
correctAnswers: Vertex AI Search for Retail (Recommendations AI)

explanation.general explanation: Vertex AI Search for Retail (formerly Recommendations AI) is a fully managed service that delivers highly personalized product recommendations at scale, leveraging Google's state-of-the-art machine learning algorithms tailored specifically for the retail industry.

why other options are wrong.Vertex AI Feature Store: Feature Store is a centralized repository for organizing, storing, and serving ML features. It is not a recommendation engine.
why other options are wrong.BigQuery ML: While you can build a recommendation model (like Matrix Factorization) in BigQuery ML, it requires custom development and maintenance, whereas Vertex AI Search for Retail is a fully managed, purpose-built solution.
why other options are wrong.Cloud Natural Language API: This API is for extracting meaning and sentiment from text, not for generating product recommendations based on user behavior.

questions.questionText: A global gaming company is developing a multiplayer mobile game featuring an in-game chat system. They want players from around the world to communicate seamlessly in real-time, regardless of their native language. Which Google Cloud service can dynamically translate chat messages between players?

explanation.general explanation: The Cloud Translation API dynamically translates text between thousands of language pairs in real-time. It is the perfect solution for translating live in-game chat messages so players can communicate in their preferred languages.

why other options are wrong.Cloud Natural Language API: This API performs sentiment analysis, entity extraction, and syntax analysis. It does not translate text between languages.
why other options are wrong.Dialogflow: Dialogflow is a natural language understanding platform used to design and integrate conversational user interfaces (chatbots), not for direct text translation between users.
why other options are wrong.Vertex AI Matching Engine: Matching Engine (Vector Search) is used for high-scale similarity search and vector embeddings, typically in generative AI or recommendation use cases, not language translation.

questions.questionText: You are tasked with building a customer service chatbot that will be embedded into your company's website. The chatbot needs to understand natural language intents, manage conversational flow, and respond to common customer queries automatically. Which Google Cloud service is designed specifically for building conversational agents?

explanation.general explanation: Dialogflow (part of Contact Center AI) is a natural language understanding platform that makes it easy to design and integrate conversational user interfaces (like chatbots and voicebots) into mobile apps, web applications, and devices.

why other options are wrong.Vertex AI Pipelines: Vertex AI Pipelines is a tool to orchestrate machine learning workflows (MLOps), not a tool to build conversational agents.
why other options are wrong.Cloud Text-to-Speech API: This API converts text into human-like speech. While it can be a component of a voicebot, it does not handle conversational logic or intent recognition.
why other options are wrong.Cloud Natural Language API: While it analyzes text, it does not manage conversational state, intent fulfillment, or dialogue flows like Dialogflow does.

questions.questionText: A news aggregator application needs to automatically scan thousands of daily news articles. The system must identify key entities (people, places, organizations) mentioned in the articles to categorize them properly. Which pre-trained Google Cloud API provides this functionality out-of-the-box?

explanation.general explanation: The Cloud Natural Language API provides pre-trained models that can instantly analyze text and identify entities (people, places, events, organizations), analyze sentiment, and understand the syntax of the text.

why other options are wrong.Cloud Vision API: Vision API is for images, not text documents or articles.
why other options are wrong.Vertex AI AutoML Text: AutoML Text is used when you need to train a custom model with specific, proprietary labels. Since standard entities (people, places) are required, the pre-trained Natural Language API is sufficient and requires no training.
why other options are wrong.Document AI: Document AI is for extracting structured data from formatted documents (like PDFs, forms, and receipts), not for entity extraction from plain text articles.

questions.questionText: A social media platform allows users to upload short video clips. To ensure platform safety, the company must automatically detect explicit content, violence, and inappropriate scenes in the videos before they are published. Which Google Cloud service should they use?

explanation.general explanation: The Cloud Video Intelligence API features pre-trained machine learning models that automatically recognize a vast number of objects, places, and actions in stored and streaming video, including built-in features for explicit content detection (content moderation).

why other options are wrong.Cloud Vision API: Vision API is designed for analyzing static images, not for processing video files or analyzing motion across video frames.
why other options are wrong.Vertex AI Custom Training: Building a custom video classification model from scratch would be highly complex and unnecessary since the pre-trained API already supports explicit content detection.
why other options are wrong.Cloud Data Loss Prevention (DLP): Cloud DLP is used to detect and mask sensitive text data (like PII, credit cards), not for analyzing visual content in videos.

questions.questionText: A healthcare provider (similar to EHR Healthcare) wants to share clinical notes with a research institution. However, they must strictly adhere to HIPAA compliance by removing Protected Health Information (PHI) from the unstructured text before sharing. Which Google Cloud service provides specialized models for identifying and de-identifying medical text?

explanation.general explanation: The Cloud Healthcare API includes specialized Natural Language Processing (NLP) capabilities designed specifically for healthcare data. It can extract medical concepts and automatically de-identify PHI from unstructured clinical text, ensuring compliance with privacy regulations.

why other options are wrong.Cloud Natural Language API: While it can identify general entities, it lacks the specialized medical models and HIPAA-compliant de-identification features required for clinical health records.
why other options are wrong.Vertex AI AutoML Text: AutoML requires you to manually label and train models. The Healthcare API provides this capability out-of-the-box.
why other options are wrong.Document AI: Document AI extracts structure from documents but is not specifically tailored for scrubbing PHI from raw, unstructured clinical notes.

questions.questionText: A data science team needs to develop custom machine learning models using Python and PyTorch. They require a fully managed, Jupyter-based interactive development environment with direct access to Google Cloud GPUs and seamless integration with BigQuery. Furthermore, once trained, they need to deploy the model to an autoscaling REST API. Which TWO services will fulfill these requirements? (Select two)

explanation.general explanation: Vertex AI Workbench is the single environment for data scientists to complete all of their ML work, providing managed Jupyter notebooks with GPU support. Once the model is ready, Vertex AI Endpoints provides fully managed, autoscaling infrastructure to serve online predictions via REST APIs.

why other options are wrong.Cloud Run: While Cloud Run can host containers, Vertex AI Endpoints is purpose-built for ML model serving, offering features like model monitoring and traffic splitting natively.
why other options are wrong.BigQuery ML: BigQuery ML is for writing models in SQL, but the scenario explicitly states the team uses Python and PyTorch.
why other options are wrong.Dataproc: Dataproc is a managed Hadoop/Spark service for big data processing, not an interactive Jupyter environment specifically tailored for deep learning workflows like PyTorch.

questions.questionText: Multiple machine learning teams across your organization are independently computing the same user statistics (e.g., 'average purchase value over 30 days') to train their models. You want to implement a centralized repository to organize, store, and serve these machine learning features to prevent duplicate effort and ensure consistency. Which service should you use?

explanation.general explanation: Vertex AI Feature Store provides a centralized repository for organizing, storing, and serving machine learning features. It allows different teams to share and discover features, preventing duplication of effort and ensuring that the same feature definitions are used for both training and online serving.

why other options are wrong.Vertex AI Model Registry: Model Registry is used to manage the lifecycle of trained machine learning models, not the input features used to train them.
why other options are wrong.Cloud Storage: While you could technically save feature files in Cloud Storage, it is a raw object store and lacks the serving, monitoring, and sharing mechanisms of a dedicated Feature Store.
why other options are wrong.BigQuery: BigQuery is a data warehouse. While features might be calculated there, Vertex AI Feature Store specifically handles low-latency serving and centralized ML feature management across the organization.

questions.questionText: A marketing agency creates promotional videos and needs to generate high-quality voiceovers from written scripts. They want to use AI to produce realistic, human-sounding voices in multiple accents without hiring voice actors. Which Google Cloud API should they use?

explanation.general explanation: The Cloud Text-to-Speech API enables developers to synthesize natural-sounding speech from text using deep learning models. It is ideal for generating voiceovers, interactive voice response (IVR) systems, and reading text aloud.

why other options are wrong.Cloud Speech-to-Text API: This API does the exact opposite; it converts spoken audio into written text.
why other options are wrong.Cloud Translation API: Translation API converts text from one language to another; it does not generate audio.
why other options are wrong.Cloud Natural Language API: This API analyzes text for sentiment and syntax; it does not synthesize speech.

questions.questionText: A machine learning engineering team wants to automate their end-to-end ML workflow. They need a serverless way to orchestrate data extraction, model training, evaluation, and deployment steps using Kubeflow Pipelines. Which Google Cloud service provides a managed environment for this orchestration?

explanation.general explanation: Vertex AI Pipelines helps you to automate, monitor, and govern your ML systems by orchestrating your ML workflows in a serverless manner. It natively supports pipelines built using the Kubeflow Pipelines SDK.

why other options are wrong.Cloud Composer: Cloud Composer (Apache Airflow) is a generalized workflow orchestration tool, typically used for data engineering pipelines, not specifically optimized for ML workflows and Kubeflow.
why other options are wrong.Cloud Build: Cloud Build is a CI/CD platform for executing builds, tests, and deployments. While it can trigger ML pipelines, it is not an ML pipeline orchestrator itself.
why other options are wrong.Cloud Data Fusion: Data Fusion is a graphical data integration service for building ETL data pipelines, not ML training pipelines.

questions.questionText: Your company receives thousands of customer support emails daily. You want to automatically classify these emails into five proprietary categories specific to your business (e.g., 'Billing Issues', 'Technical Support', 'Feature Requests'). You have a dataset of historical emails mapped to these categories. Which service allows you to train a custom model without writing any code?

explanation.general explanation: Vertex AI AutoML Text enables you to train highly accurate custom machine learning models to classify text documents according to proprietary labels defined by your business, without requiring any ML coding expertise.

why other options are wrong.Cloud Natural Language API: The pre-trained Natural Language API provides generic sentiment and standard entity extraction. It cannot categorize text into proprietary, custom-defined business categories out-of-the-box.
why other options are wrong.BigQuery ML: While you could build a classification model in BigQuery ML, it requires writing SQL and understanding ML algorithms, whereas AutoML is a no-code solution.
why other options are wrong.Document AI: Document AI is focused on extracting structured data from formatted documents (like PDFs or receipts), not classifying plain text emails.

questions.questionText: Your finance team stores historical daily sales data in BigQuery. They want to forecast sales for the next 30 days using time-series analysis to improve budget planning. The team is highly proficient in SQL but has no machine learning experience. What is the most efficient way to generate these forecasts?
options: Use BigQuery ML to create an ARIMA_PLUS model.
Export the data to Cloud Storage and use Vertex AI Custom Training.
Use the Cloud Natural Language API on the sales logs.
Build a Dataflow pipeline to stream data into an external forecasting tool.
correctAnswers: Use BigQuery ML to create an ARIMA_PLUS model.

explanation.general explanation: BigQuery ML supports time-series forecasting using the ARIMA_PLUS model directly via standard SQL queries. This allows the finance team to leverage their existing SQL skills to build sophisticated forecasting models without moving data or learning Python.

why other options are wrong.Export the data to Cloud Storage and use: This requires exporting data and writing custom ML code, which is inefficient and outside the skill set of the SQL-proficient finance team.
why other options are wrong.Use the Cloud Natural Language API on th: Natural Language API analyzes text. It cannot perform numerical time-series forecasting.
why other options are wrong.Build a Dataflow pipeline to stream data: This introduces unnecessary complexity and operational overhead when BigQuery natively supports the capability.

questions.questionText: A travel app allows users to take photos of street signs and famous monuments. The app needs to extract text from the street signs (OCR) and identify the names of the famous monuments. Which pre-trained Google Cloud API provides both of these capabilities?

explanation.general explanation: The Cloud Vision API is a pre-trained service that can extract text from images (Optical Character Recognition - OCR), detect famous landmarks, identify logos, and classify common objects without requiring any custom model training.

why other options are wrong.Cloud Natural Language API: This API processes text documents, it does not process images.
why other options are wrong.Vertex AI AutoML Vision: AutoML Vision is for training custom image models. Since street signs and famous monuments are common entities, the pre-trained Vision API is the right choice.
why other options are wrong.Document AI: While Document AI does OCR, it is optimized for structured documents (forms, invoices) rather than raw photos of street signs and monuments.

questions.questionText: A global news agency receives photos of printed newspapers from different countries. They need an automated pipeline to extract the foreign language text from these images and immediately convert it into English. Which TWO Google Cloud services are required for this pipeline? (Select two)

explanation.general explanation: The Cloud Vision API (specifically its OCR capability) is required to extract the raw text from the image of the newspaper. Once the text is extracted, the Cloud Translation API is used to convert the foreign language text into English.

why other options are wrong.Cloud Speech-to-Text API: This is used for transcribing spoken audio into text, not for reading text from images.
why other options are wrong.Document AI: While Document AI can do OCR, Cloud Vision API is typically the direct and lighter-weight choice for raw OCR extraction before passing to translation, though Document AI could be used if it was a structured form. Vision API is the standard answer for plain image OCR.
why other options are wrong.Cloud Natural Language API: This API performs sentiment and entity analysis on text, it does not translate languages.

questions.questionText: Your company runs a large customer support call center. Instead of replacing human agents with chatbots, you want to use AI to analyze live audio during calls to provide human agents with real-time suggested articles and responses based on the customer's intent. Which solution fits this requirement?

explanation.general explanation: Contact Center AI (CCAI) includes a feature called Agent Assist. It transcribes live calls in real-time, analyzes the conversation intent, and provides live human agents with suggested responses, knowledge base articles, and step-by-step guidance.

why other options are wrong.Cloud Text-to-Speech API: This service converts text to audio; it does not analyze live customer audio to provide agent suggestions.
why other options are wrong.Vertex AI Batch Prediction: Batch Prediction is for analyzing large datasets asynchronously offline, not for real-time, low-latency live call analysis.
why other options are wrong.Cloud Video Intelligence API: This API analyzes video files, not real-time customer support audio calls.

questions.questionText: A legal firm possesses hundreds of lengthy contracts in PDF and Microsoft Word format written in German. They need to translate all these documents into English while strictly preserving the original document formatting, layouts, and embedded images. Which Google Cloud service provides this capability?

explanation.general explanation: Cloud Translation API Advanced provides a document translation feature that allows you to translate whole documents (like PDFs and Word documents) directly while preserving their original formatting and layout.

why other options are wrong.Cloud Natural Language API: This service does not translate text; it analyzes sentiment and entities.
why other options are wrong.Document AI: Document AI extracts structured data from documents; it does not translate the content between languages.
why other options are wrong.Cloud Vision API: While Vision API can extract text (OCR) from PDFs, it will output raw text strings and will not translate or preserve the original document layout.

questions.questionText: You are acting as the cloud architect for Mountkirk Games. They have a massive dataset of player behavior in tabular format (CSV files in Cloud Storage). They want to quickly build a model to predict which players are likely to purchase an expansion pack, but the data science team is currently overbooked. Which no-code solution allows the data engineering team to train a high-quality model on this tabular data?

explanation.general explanation: Vertex AI AutoML Tabular allows users to build, train, and deploy high-quality machine learning models on structured (tabular) data without having to write any ML training code.

why other options are wrong.Vertex AI Custom Training: Custom training requires writing complex ML code (e.g., Python, TensorFlow), which the overbooked data science team handles, making it unsuitable for a no-code requirement.
why other options are wrong.Cloud Natural Language API: This is for unstructured text analysis, not for structured tabular data.
why other options are wrong.Recommendations AI: While related to purchases, Recommendations AI is designed for e-commerce product recommendations, not binary classification (predicting if a specific player will buy an expansion pack).

questions.questionText: Your machine learning team has trained several different versions of a fraud detection model over the past year. They need a centralized Google Cloud service to store, version, and evaluate these trained models before deciding which specific version to deploy to production. Which service is designed for this lifecycle management?

explanation.general explanation: Vertex AI Model Registry is a central repository where you can manage the lifecycle of your ML models. It allows you to store, version, and evaluate models, making it easy to track lineage and deploy specific versions to endpoints.

why other options are wrong.Vertex AI Feature Store: Feature Store manages the input features used to train models, not the trained models themselves.
why other options are wrong.Cloud Storage: While you can store model artifacts (like saved_model.pb) in Cloud Storage, it lacks built-in versioning, evaluation metrics, and deployment integrations specific to ML models.
why other options are wrong.Vertex AI Workbench: Workbench is an interactive development environment (Jupyter notebooks) for writing code, not a repository for managing trained model lifecycles.

questions.questionText: You have a machine learning model deployed in production that predicts housing prices. Six months after deployment, you suspect the model's accuracy is degrading because the real-world housing data has changed significantly since the model was trained. Which Google Cloud service can automatically detect this data drift and alert you?

explanation.general explanation: Vertex AI Model Monitoring automatically tracks deployed models and alerts you when incoming prediction requests deviate significantly from the data used to train the model (data drift or training-serving skew).

why other options are wrong.Cloud Monitoring (formerly Stackdriver): Cloud Monitoring tracks infrastructure metrics (CPU, memory, latency). It does not natively analyze statistical distributions of ML model inputs for data drift.
why other options are wrong.Vertex AI Pipelines: Pipelines orchestrate the ML training process. While a pipeline might be triggered by model monitoring to retrain a model, it does not do the monitoring itself.
why other options are wrong.Dataflow: Dataflow is a data processing service. It does not natively monitor deployed ML endpoints for statistical data drift.

questions.questionText: A startup has developed an innovative scikit-learn model locally on their laptops. They want to upload this trained model artifact to Google Cloud and have a fully managed REST API automatically created for it, which can auto-scale based on incoming traffic for online predictions. Which service should they use?

explanation.general explanation: Vertex AI Endpoints allows you to deploy trained models (including scikit-learn, TensorFlow, and PyTorch) to a fully managed, autoscaling HTTP endpoint to serve online predictions with low latency.

why other options are wrong.BigQuery ML: BigQuery ML models are trained and executed using SQL queries within the data warehouse, not deployed as standalone HTTP APIs from externally trained artifacts.
why other options are wrong.Vertex AI Custom Training: This service is used for training the model, but the scenario states the model is already trained locally and just needs to be served.
why other options are wrong.Compute Engine: While you could manually set up a web server on a VM to host the model, it is not a fully managed service and requires you to manage the autoscaling, OS, and web server software manually.

questions.questionText: A financial advisory firm processes tax documents (such as W-2 forms) submitted by their clients. They need to automatically extract specific fields like 'Employer Name', 'Wages', and 'Tax Withheld' from these scanned forms. Which Google Cloud service offers pre-trained models tailored for this exact task?

explanation.general explanation: Document AI includes specialized parsers (like the W-2 parser) that are pre-trained to understand the structure of specific documents and extract specific key-value pairs (like Wages and Employer Name) automatically.

why other options are wrong.Cloud Vision API: Vision API can extract raw text from the image, but it does not inherently understand what a W-2 form is or structure the output into key-value pairs.
why other options are wrong.Vertex AI AutoML Text: AutoML Text classifies text or extracts custom entities from plain text, but is not designed for parsing structured visual documents like tax forms.
why other options are wrong.Cloud Data Loss Prevention (DLP): Cloud DLP is for discovering and masking sensitive data (like SSNs), not for general form parsing and structured extraction.

questions.questionText: A hospital receives hundreds of patient feedback forms in Spanish. The administration wants an automated pipeline that first converts these reviews into English and then analyzes the English text to determine if the overall patient sentiment was positive or negative. Which TWO Google Cloud services are required? (Select two)

explanation.general explanation: The pipeline requires the Cloud Translation API to convert the Spanish text into English. Once translated, the Cloud Natural Language API is used to perform sentiment analysis on the English text to determine if the feedback is positive or negative.

why other options are wrong.Cloud Vision API: Vision API is for image analysis, not for processing and translating text feedback.
why other options are wrong.Dialogflow: Dialogflow is used to build conversational agents (chatbots), not for batch processing written reviews for sentiment.
why other options are wrong.Vertex AI Workbench: Workbench is a Jupyter environment for data scientists. While you could write custom code here, leveraging the pre-trained Translation and NLP APIs is the direct, intended solution for this architectural pipeline.

questions.questionText: You are migrating an e-commerce platform to Google Cloud. The business wants to leverage machine learning to show users products they are likely to buy, based on what they are currently viewing and their past purchase history. They want a fully managed service that specializes in retail catalog integration. Which service fits best?
options: Vertex AI Search for Retail (Recommendations AI)
correctAnswers: Vertex AI Search for Retail (Recommendations AI)

explanation.general explanation: Vertex AI Search for Retail (formerly Recommendations AI) is Google's fully managed service designed specifically to deliver highly personalized product recommendations by ingesting catalog and user event data.

why other options are wrong.Vertex AI AutoML Tabular: While AutoML can predict outcomes on tabular data, it is not a purpose-built recommendation engine that seamlessly handles retail catalogs and continuous user event streams.
why other options are wrong.BigQuery ML: You can build matrix factorization models in BQML for recommendations, but it requires manual SQL coding, model tuning, and custom deployment, unlike the fully managed Retail API.
why other options are wrong.Cloud Vision API: Vision API analyzes images. It does not provide product recommendations based on user history.

questions.questionText: A media company records thousands of video interviews. They need to automatically generate text transcripts of the spoken words in these videos and then identify the names of specific politicians and locations mentioned in those transcripts. Which TWO Google Cloud services should be combined to accomplish this? (Select two)

explanation.general explanation: To extract the spoken words from the video interviews, you first use the Cloud Speech-to-Text API (or Video Intelligence API's transcription feature) to generate a text transcript. Then, you pass that transcript to the Cloud Natural Language API to extract entities (politicians, locations).

why other options are wrong.Cloud Translation API: This API translates text between languages; the scenario does not mention language translation.
why other options are wrong.Document AI: Document AI extracts structured data from visual documents like PDFs, not from video or audio transcripts.
why other options are wrong.Cloud Text-to-Speech API: This service synthesizes spoken audio from text, which is the exact reverse of what is needed.

questions.questionText: You are building a generative AI application that requires retrieving documents based on semantic similarity rather than exact keyword matches. To do this, you need to store millions of vector embeddings generated from your text data and perform ultra-fast similarity searches against them. Which TWO Google Cloud services natively support vector storage and similarity search? (Select two)

explanation.general explanation: Vertex AI Vector Search (formerly Matching Engine) is an industry-leading high-scale vector database optimized for similarity search. Additionally, Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL natively supports the 'pgvector' extension, allowing you to store vector embeddings and perform similarity searches directly alongside your relational data.

why other options are wrong.Cloud CDN: Cloud CDN is a content delivery network for caching web assets; it has no database or vector search capabilities.
why other options are wrong.Cloud Storage: Cloud Storage is an object storage service. While it can store the raw files or model artifacts, it cannot perform native semantic similarity searches or index vector embeddings.
why other options are wrong.Pub/Sub: Pub/Sub is a messaging service for event-driven architectures, not a database for storing and querying vector embeddings.
